title: One hand run per store, before release

steps.label:
Fake webhook events: renewal grants,
stale event ignored, transfer moves row

Fresh sandbox account subscribes
through the introductory offer

Entitlement active, webhook lands
the Allowance

Subscription cancelled: account
meets the paywall

Written up with the release;
never a CI step

example: Release 1.27.0: one App Store run, one Play run, logged.
